<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00FBFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#09C9E3"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">9:41</text>
    <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="335" y2="16" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="19" x2="335" y2="19" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="14" x2="338" y2="20" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="12" x2="342" y2="20" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="10" x2="346" y2="20" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="355" y1="16" x2="363" y2="16" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="370" y="10" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="372" y="12" width="12" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <line x1="389" y1="13" x2="389" y2="18" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="25,49 18,56 25,63" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="42" y="61" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Returns</text>
    <circle cx="352" cy="56" r="17" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="51" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="352" cy="61" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="16" y1="78" x2="374" y2="78" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".12"/>

  <!-- Five-step progress -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="100" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">RETURN REQUEST</text>
    <text x="302" y="100" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".6">Step 2 of 5</text>

    <line x1="51" y1="126" x2="108" y2="126" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" opacity=".35"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="126" x2="189" y2="126" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" opacity=".35"/>
    <line x1="213" y1="126" x2="270" y2="126" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" opacity=".18"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="126" x2="351" y2="126" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" opacity=".18"/>

    <circle cx="40" cy="126" r="20" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <polyline points="32,126 38,132 49,120" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="40" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Order</text>

    <circle cx="121" cy="126" r="20" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <circle cx="121" cy="121" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="121" cy="130" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="121" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Details</text>

    <circle cx="202" cy="126" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="195,126 202,119 209,126 202,133 195,126" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="202" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">Refund</text>

    <circle cx="283" cy="126" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="275,126 281,132 291,120" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="283" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">Review</text>

    <circle cx="364" cy="126" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="357,126 364,119 371,126 364,133 357,126" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="364" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">Done</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="195" font-family="Inter" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#0D0543">Return my order(s)</text>
    <text x="20" y="220" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Tell us why you would like to return this item.</text>
    <text x="20" y="240" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Your feedback helps us improve your experience.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Order card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="258" width="350" height="2" rx="8" fill="#1018280D"/>
    <rect x="20" y="256" width="350" height="96" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".14"/>
    <rect x="32" y="270" width="70" height="68" rx="8" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="280" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="39,329 55,310 67,320 77,306 96,329" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <text x="116" y="278" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">ORDER #45892176</text>
    <text x="116" y="299" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Everyday cotton shirt</text>
    <text x="116" y="320" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Navy blue · Size M · Qty 1</text>
    <text x="116" y="340" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">$29.00</text>
    <rect x="307" y="268" width="51" height="22" rx="11" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="332" y="283" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">DELIVERED</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Reason section -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="382" font-family="Inter" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">What is the reason for return?</text>
    <text x="20" y="404" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".7">Select one option to continue.</text>

    <!-- selected reason -->
    <rect x="20" y="421" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#1018280D"/>
    <rect x="20" y="419" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="448" r="10" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="448" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="70" y="444" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Item doesn’t fit</text>
    <text x="70" y="463" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">The size or fit isn’t right for me</text>
    <polyline points="340,441 346,447 340,453" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- reason 2 -->
    <rect x="20" y="489" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="518" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="70" y="514" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Item arrived damaged</text>
    <text x="70" y="533" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">The product was damaged in transit</text>
    <polyline points="340,511 346,517 340,523" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- reason 3 -->
    <rect x="20" y="557" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="586" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="70" y="582" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Received the wrong item</text>
    <text x="70" y="601" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">The item is different from my order</text>
    <polyline points="340,579 346,585 340,591" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- reason 4 -->
    <rect x="20" y="625" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="654" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="70" y="650" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Changed my mind</text>
    <text x="70" y="669" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">I no longer need or want this item</text>
    <polyline points="340,647 346,653 340,659" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="715" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".65">You can add more details on the next step.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="733" width="104" height="40" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="72" y="758" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Go back</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="140" y="733" width="230" height="40" rx="8" fill="#0D0543"/>
      <text x="255" y="758" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
      <polyline points="334,750 340,756 334,762" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="786" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="786" x2="390" y2="786" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-opacity=".12"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="35,806 44,798 53,806 53,817 47,817 47,811 41,811 41,817 35,817" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="44" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".7">Home</text>

    <circle cx="122" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="812" x2="134" y2="818" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="122" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".7">Search</text>

    <rect x="181" y="798" width="18" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="804" x2="199" y2="804" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="186" y1="795" x2="186" y2="801" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="194" y1="795" x2="194" y2="801" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="190" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Orders</text>

    <polyline points="266,802 272,799 278,802 277,809 272,813 267,809 266,802" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="272" cy="805" r="2" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <text x="272" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".7">Offers</text>

    <circle cx="345" cy="803" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="813" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="345" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543" opacity=".7">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
